question: The Lebang Boomani Dance is part of the folk dance repertoire of which of these Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lebang Boomani Dance is also known as '**Lebang Bumani.**
 
• Is an interesting** harvest dance form**.
 
• The dance movements of Lebang Boomani dancers portray the procedure of catching these** tiny insects with the aid of bamboo clappers.**
 
• Instruments include** Khamb, Flute, Sarinda and 'Pungi**'in Lebang Boomani dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Tripura ( as of Aug 2022**)

 
 
• Capital-**Agartala**.
 
• chief Minister-**Manik saha.**
 
• Governor-**Satyadev Narayan Arya.**
 
• Tripura is** surrounded by Bangladesh** on its north, south and west.
 
• Tripura is famous for its** cultivations**, **tea plantations, beautiful gardens, toy trains** and much more.
 
• The main folk dances of Tripura are – the **Hozagiri dance**,** Garia, Jhum.**​
